thread:
Maya: T-minus 30 for the midday slice cutover (sliced-routing-v3). Plan: canary -> ramp -> verify -> full. Rollback owner: Omar. Can everyone ack readiness?

Omar: Ack. I will own rollback and watch error-rate + p99. Have alert runbook open.

Devon: Quick checklist I ran through: infra config ✅, job config ✅, canary lane allocated ✅. Dashboards: still finishing some panels (posting links in a sec).

Sasha: Quick Q — are we using the new batching config for this rollout? That will change token latency a bit.

Maya: Yes we are switching to batch-config v2 for canary only. We measured ~8% cost reduction. Watch p95 latency during canary.

Devon: Smoke steps (run these after canary starts):
```
# 1. check rollout status
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/sliced-routing-v3-canary
# 2. basic health endpoint
curl -fsS https://api.redwood.prod/health | jq .
# 3. sample generation smoke (short seq)
python infra/smoke/smoke_generate.py --model sliced-routing-v3 --prompt 'Hello' --length 32
```

Luis: Dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/prod/sliced-routing (added p50/p95/p99 & error-rate). I also pinned the synthetic job to run every 2m during ramp.

Sasha: Thanks — I'll run the smoke scripts and post results. I can confirm tokenization and routing headers look ok.

Maya: Ok target cadence: 2% for 5m, 10% for 7m, 40% for 10m, then assess for full. If error-rate > 1.5% or p95 > 600ms -> immediate rollback.

Omar: Copy that. Rollback sequence: 1) toggle traffic back to primary lane 2) disable new batching config 3) redeploy previous replica set. I will post timestamps when I start.

deploy-bot: Canary stage started by maya at 1767777789. Allocated 2% traffic to canary pool.

Sasha: Smoke run: health OK, sample gen returned in 210ms, tokens look good. No 5xx. Posting logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/streams/1767777795

Devon: Running extra regression prompt set now (10 prompts) — all passed semantic checks. Will keep an eye on rerank metrics.

Maya: Requesting sign-offs: reply with ":thumbsup:" to proceed to 10%.

Luis: :thumbsup: from infra/monitoring side.

Omar: :thumbsup: I'm on-call for rollback.

Sasha: :thumbsup: smoke passed.

Devon: :thumbsup: regression looks clean.

Maya: Proceeding to 10% at 1767777815. Will post updates each step.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 10% at 1767777816 by maya.

Maya: 10% warmup done. p95 250ms, errors 0.4% (within target). Proceeding to 40% at +7m if stable.

Omar: All good here. If I see >1.5% error or sustained p95 > 600ms I will initiate rollback.

Devon: Noted. If rollback needed, here's the quick command I use: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/sliced-routing-v3 -n prod --to-revision=$(history-revision-id)` — Omar, I'll standby to assist.

Maya: Thanks team. Final note: please log any anomalies in the runbook confluence page: https://confluence.redwood/deploys/sliced-routing-v3 (I will capture timestamps).
